annotation_type: independent model annotations; not human validation

identity.exact_snapshot_limitation: Exact serving model identifier is not exposed to this agent.

label_definition.no: no error established in assessable evidence

method: Independent row-by-row model judgments from raw responses and supplied evidence. Local Python standard JSON parsing and official jsonschema used only for objective syntax/schema checks. Schema cells read with json.loads or ast.literal_eval, never eval. Semantic judgments manually recorded per row. Embedded SchemaToJSON records decoded for coordinate/content comparison; whitespace differences in serialized records ignored. No child-object salvage from invalid parent answers; Python program intermediates not treated as JSON answers.
completion_policy: Clear interrupted token/value/field or abandoned answer => yes. Finished wrong delimiter => no. Missing parent closure alone with otherwise finished substantive content => not-assessable.
envelope_policy: Raw prose or Markdown fences count as contamination even when NL-to-format prompt requests prose; code-like words inside JSON strings do not count.
schema_policy: Only actual supplied schema cell used; missing schema => not-assessable. Invalid intended answer => schema not-assessable.
content_policy: Parseable intended answer required. Gold used as comparison evidence, not sufficient proof that differing grounded paraphrases are wrong. Missing prompt/source limits interpretation of semantic/path/classification differences. Internal contradictions, impossible evidence spans, and unequal coordinate/record pairing count as independently observable errors. Ordinary common-noun allergy capitalization judged semantically equivalent in context. Field relocation judged contextually when source available.

limitations.reviewer_blinding: One model-agent review; independent from reviewer B but no claim of independent model family or human reliability.
limitations.long_responses: Long repetitive invalid outputs inspected through manageable excerpts plus full-input strict parsing; clearly interrupted endings or invalid parent structure were not repaired to infer content.
limitations.no_external_ground_truth: No outside sources consulted; no factual source verification beyond supplied sample.

validation.objective_schema_and_parser_crosscheck: All applicable supplied schemas checked using official jsonschema; no disagreements with recorded syntax/schema decisions.

scope: All 230 annotation_sample.csv rows, all five dimensions, independently annotated by reviewer A; no adjudication against other reviewer labels.
